# Spec: Label an image without training

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/label-an-image.md)

**Start:** `/ai/images`  
**Persona:** A developer adding image understanding  
**Goal:** Rank free-text labels against a picture and see its embedding.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Choose an image | The Classify and Embed buttons are enabled. |
| 2 | Rank the labels | A table lists the labels with probabilities, best first. |
